title: spider world
description: this texture pack change the texture of the wolf to become a spider wolf (spider man but in a wolf body) and change the texture of the iron golem to become a hulk golem. Also this texture pack change the texture of the blue terracota and the accacia log
body:
This texture pack changes the look of : The Iron golem , Blue terracota , Wolf , Accacia log,
- the iron becomes hulk
- the wolf become spider man 
- the accacia become a spider man block 
- the blue terracota become a hulk block 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
i made this texture pack for my little brother who loves these characters ❤️ 
> making an update at 1 download ❤️
